entities.name: 1977 Benghazi Libyan Arab Airlines Tu-154 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 2 December 1977, a Tupolev Tu-154 passenger jet ran out of fuel and made a forced landing near Benghazi, Libya. A total of 59 passengers were killed.
